goal: Implement BIP 54 consensus cleanup validation rules on regtest without activating them on mainnet
Fix legacy flaws like quadratic sigop exhaustion, 64-byte Merkle tree collisions, and timewarp attacks
Allow developers and node operators to test and exercise BIP 54 validation logic in Bitcoin Core
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Wide concept approval to make BIP 54 logic available without mainnet activation (0xB10C)
Concept approval without stated reasons (fanquake, dergoegge, fjahr, polespinasa, stickies-v)
Open question on cache behavior and mempool reorg edge case test coverage (ariard)
Open question on whether activation should start at height 1 instead of genesis (murchandamus)
Previous objections around miner enforcement and check categorization resolved (fjahr, polespinasa)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it implements consensus rules fixing quadratic sigop exhaustion and timewarp exploits
Provides high strategic value for testing consensus cleanup rules ahead of any soft fork
Carries no immediate mainnet impact because rules are strictly limited to regtest
